name: Wayfinder
description: Chisel navigation marks into cave walls, floors, and ceilings — arrows, explored, danger, resources, home, water, dead end, cache, and translocator markers etched directly into the rock. Hold a chisel without a hammer and Sneak+Right-Click any rock surface. No copper yet? Scratch marks with flint, chert, obsidian, or an antler instead (flint and stones mark walls and ceilings only, so floor knapping still works). Cycle mark types with Ctrl+U; an icon beside the hotbar shows the selected mark while you hold a marking tool.
